title: DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32002v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid growth of microdramas has increased demand for high-quality script production. Long-form microdrama script generation with LLMs requires both diverse plot progression and long-range narrative coherence. Our observations reveal that candidate continuations increasingly concentrate on fewer narrative mechanisms as generation progresses, while conventional retrieval may reinforce trope reuse and overlook historical information essential to future plots. To address these challenges, we propose DraMaze, a multi-agent pipeline that explores diverse causal paths through trope memory-guided evolutionary tree search and mutation. It further constructs a Backward Narrative Dependency Tree to organize, retain, and retrieve historical memories based on future narrative goals. translated_title: DraMaze：具有前瞻记忆的多智能体流水线，用于多样化微短剧剧本生成
translated_abstract: 微短剧的快速增长增加了对高质量剧本制作的需求。使用大语言模型进行长篇微短剧剧本生成，需要同时具备多样化的情节推进和长程叙事连贯性。我们的观察发现，随着生成过程的推进，候选续写越来越集中于少数叙事机制，而传统检索方法可能强化套路化复用，并忽略对后续情节至关重要的历史信息。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了DraMaze，一个通过套路记忆引导的进化树搜索和变异来探索多样化因果路径的多智能体流水线。该方法进一步构建了反向叙事依赖树，基于未来叙事目标来组织、保留和检索历史记忆。我们还推出了MiDramaBench，一个用于评估不同剧本长度下剧本逻辑与创意质量的双语基准，并配有因果模式（causal-pattern）相关评测……
tldr: 提出DraMaze多智能体流水线，通过套路记忆引导的进化树搜索和基于未来叙事目标的反向叙事依赖树，实现既多样又保持长程连贯的微短剧剧本生成，并发布双语评测基准MiDramaBench。
en_tdlr: DraMaze is a multi-agent pipeline that generates diverse and long-range coherent microdrama scripts via trope memory-guided evolutionary tree search and a future-aware Backward Narrative Dependency Tree, accompanied by the bilingual benchmark MiDramaBench.
